narrative.offerRewardText: So, you pulled a fast one on ol' Miblon, eh?
narrative.requestItemsText:
Bring me an Evoroot, and sure, I can make ya that Videre Elixir.

I know all kinds of things about herbs and alchemy... Why, let me tell you the story about the time I transmuted gold from the cheese I was going to eat for lunch... hey... Where are you going?
